Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Edit and adapt the provided existing game artwork into a finished promotional artwork for the user's game 快乐萌宠消.
Input roles: image 1 is the existing woodland character/background artwork to adapt; image 2 is the existing animal-head artwork to reuse faithfully; image 3, when supplied, is the exact existing logo design to preserve.
Preserve the recognizable character identities: warm ivory rabbit with long pink-inner ears and closed happy eyes, ivory/charcoal panda with black round eyes, honey maple ox with dark horns and bell, walnut monkey with cream face and pink cheeks. Preserve the source natural hand-carved wood grain, rounded sanded bevels, walnut and honey maple, ivory inlay, sage-green woodland, soft warm daylight. Premium tactile wooden miniature aesthetic, polished friendly game marketing illustration, crisp large forms readable at mobile thumbnail size. Fully opaque artwork, edge-to-edge composition. No plastic or plush textures.
Game is a STACKED TILE SELECTION game with carved animal faces on thick ivory rounded square tiles with honey wood sides, matched in a seven-slot horizontal wooden tray. NOT a swap-grid or path-connecting game. Tiles must remain anatomically clean with one face each. No arrows suggesting swaps. No coins, cash, prizes, discounts, ranking claims, phones, store badges, QR codes, watermarks or fake app interface. Keep important text, faces and tiles at least 7% away from canvas edges. No text beyond the exact requested copy.
Asset: a very wide 2.6:1 horizontal marketing COVER, requested canvas 2080x800, later exported as 650x250. Recompose the existing artwork across the wide canvas. Four source wooden animal mascots huddle joyfully across the left-middle, with panda tall at back, rabbit at front, ox and monkey adjoining. Right foreground clearly displays THREE identical rabbit-face square matching tiles resting side-by-side on honey wood, surrounded by a few gently floating green leaves suggesting a successful match. Keep all rabbit ears and all tile edges entirely visible. Woodland workshop background, bright inviting dappled light, soft defocused green depth; one thin tree branch frames only an outer corner. The character huddle and three tiles should fill most of the horizontal width and height with easy-to-recognize silhouettes; avoid unnecessary empty space. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO GAME TITLE, NO LOGO, NO APP ICON, NO BUTTON, NO LABEL. Do not create a frame, diptych or contact sheet.

intro_options.text: 点击萌宠入槽，三种规则巧消除
木雕萌宠消除，三种玩法轻松闯关
经典三消、极限四消、趣味两对消
森林木作萌宠，动脑搭配巧消除
叠层选牌巧消除，和萌宠一起闯关
集齐相同萌宠，挑战三种消除规则

corrections.reason: 初次生成的横版四消图收纳槽为八格，改为四个老虎牌加三个空位，共七格；其他构图和文字保留。
corrections.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This input image is the edit target. Keep the whole promotional image unchanged except correcting the foreground wooden tray. Preserve ALL Chinese text exactly as visible: 快乐萌宠消, 极限四消, 集齐四个相同萌宠. Preserve logo, characters, stacked board, warm woodland background, colors, materials, lighting and 16:9 framing.
The current tray incorrectly has eight slots. Replace ONLY that foreground tray with a tray of EXACTLY SEVEN slots total. There must be EXACTLY FOUR matching tiger tiles filling the first four wells on the left, then EXACTLY THREE empty wells on the right. Slot sequence: [TIGER] [TIGER] [TIGER] [TIGER] [EMPTY] [EMPTY] [EMPTY]. Count seven total, not eight. No extra well anywhere. Keep the four tiger faces, delicate golden matching glow, and all three empty slots clearly visible. Adjust the widths of the seven wells within the existing tray footprint naturally. Same premium honey wood, smooth ivory tiles, correct perspective. Do not change any other artwork or add any text, labels or symbols. Output one landscape 16:9 image.
